what: While the black stage enters the screen, the center card (width 996px · ratio 560/996 · corner 15px, never exceeding screen width −120) grows until it fills the stage completely. The .6 → 1 range of the ratio the stage top has entered from below the screen (1 − top/screen height) is eased with a cubic in-out: width and height grow to the stage size, and corners go 15px → 0. On phones (480 and below) it is full from the start. A section where a card video becomes the screen, with a video or image flip (scrub-frames) placed inside.

options.gap: Total margin subtracted from screen width for cards (px), default 120
options.from: Entry ratio at which growth starts, default .6
options.narrow: At this width or below, it fills fully from the start, default 480
options.stage: Stage css (default parent element) — measures its size and the ratio that has entered. If the stage is sticky, set the outer panel with trigger
options.trigger: Panel css that measures the entering ratio (default: nearest section of the stage)

from.where: index.html scroll film .vb-film__media — original ScrollFilm (card min(996, width−120) · 560/996 · 15px, progress (o−.6)/.4 through easeInOutCubic)

note: position:absolute on the element; inset:0; With margin:auto it sits in the center of the stage. The size is written inline on every scroll
